customer_name: TAL Education Group (好未来教育集团)
business_problem: TAL needed production-grade AI infrastructure and large-model tooling that could train, validate, secure, and deploy its self-developed MathGPT model quickly enough for real education products, while keeping resource efficiency and ROI under control.
solution_summary: Baidu AI Cloud supported TAL's self-developed MathGPT model with a high-performance training and serving stack built around the Baige AI heterogeneous computing platform and the Qianfan large-model platform. Baige supplied the cloud-native AI compute layer for large-scale deep-learning workloads, including cluster operations, task lifecycle management, training and inference acceleration, fault tolerance, and intelligent fault diagnosis. TAL used that environment to start projects quickly, validate base-model choices, and iterate MathGPT efficiently with its own educational data and business feedback. On the model-development side, TAL emphasized Qianfan's full-stack workflow support, efficient supervised fine-tuning, plugin extensibility, and security controls, while Baidu also contributed a lifecycle-oriented large-model security solution derived from ERNIE practices. The resulting platform let TAL move from training and validation into real product deployment on the xPad learning device, where MathGPT powers interactive math help and other AI education tools.

solution_components.name: Baige AI Heterogeneous Computing Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the cloud-native AI compute, cluster operations, acceleration, and fault-tolerant runtime that TAL uses to train and validate MathGPT.

solution_components.name: Qianfan Large Model Platform
solution_components.role: Supplies the full-stack large-model development workflow, SFT tuning, plugin support, and service runtime used to adapt MathGPT to education scenarios.

solution_components.name: Large Model Security Solution
solution_components.role: Adds security controls across training, fine-tuning, inference, deployment, and business operations for TAL's education-facing large-model services.

data_flow: Educational data and business feedback are used to validate and fine-tune MathGPT on Baige and Qianfan, accelerated training and inference pipelines prepare the model for production, and the tuned model is embedded into xPad learning workflows to answer math questions, generate AI explanations, and support other study tools.
business_outcome: TAL shortened the path from model development to classroom productization, improved learning-device experiences, and gained an AI foundation that can answer most math questions instantly while controlling compute efficiency and operational risk.
metrics: 80% of math questions can be answered instantly
human explanation video can be uploaded within 1 hour
AI video explanation can be generated within 20 minutes
